verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an official MCP server explicitly designed to give 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer' so 'technical and non-technical teams can collaborate with AI using the same authorized context,' and independent evidence confirms a viral open-source MCP already connects ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Windsurf to shared memories. Container-tag scoping ensures the same user's memory persists across these connected tools. missing for 10: no first-party hands-on walkthrough showing simultaneous Claude+ChatGPT+Cursor sessions reading the same memory in real time, and one community comment raises friction (mandatory OAuth) that could limit some assistant integrations.
